title: Rehabilitation for Parkinson's disease
what: These are regular sessions that help you keep movement, balance, speech and independence for longer. They are led by a rehabilitation therapist, a speech therapist and other specialists.
why: For Parkinson's disease at any stage - together with the medicines your neurologist prescribed.
duration: a session usually takes 45 to 60 minutes, and you need to keep doing it regularly
tell_doctor: When you take your medicines and when they work best
Whether you freeze when walking or fall
What is hardest for you now at home

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not change your schedule on your own. Come to sessions in the hours when your medicines work best.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: Comfortable clothes and steady shoes without laces.

prepare.title: Company
prepare.text: It is good if a close person comes to the first sessions - they will be shown the exercises too.

bring: A list of your medicines and the times you take them
steps: The specialist checks your walking, balance and strength
You train big steps and walking to a count or rhythm
You do exercises for balance and turning
You are taught to stand up from a chair and from bed
A speech therapist works on speech and swallowing, if needed
You are given a plan of exercises for every day
feel: Sessions can be tiring - the pace is set to suit you
Movement is easier on some days than on others - this is normal
after: Remove rugs and cords from the floor and put in handrails
Tell your neurologist if you have started to fall more often
red_flags: A fall with severe pain or a blow to the head - call your local emergency number
Choking, coughing and struggling to breathe - call your local emergency number
A sudden worsening of movement or confusion

faq.q: Do exercises help if I take medicines?
faq.a: Yes. Medicines and sessions work together, and exercises help you keep movement for longer.

faq.q: What if my feet freeze when I walk?
faq.a: Stop, take a breath, start a step to a count, or step over an imaginary line. The specialist will show you tricks.

reminders.text: Rehabilitation session today. Take your medicines at your usual time and bring comfortable shoes.
